concerns.text: Task T021a implements a '1.5B distilled' baseline, violating Constitution Principle VII and FR-004 which mandate the 'original FastContext (4B model)' as the primary baseline. This silently relaxes the experimental design to a different model, invalidating the comparison against the spec's defined baseline.

Task T021a includes logic to 'limit the run to the Regular set', violating Constitution Principle VI which requires 'All comparative evaluations... MUST be stratified by this stratification'. This drops the required paired baseline data for the 'Irregular' set, making FR-006 (degradation calculation) impossible to satisfy.

Task T028b restricts the 'continuous regression analysis' to the 'Regular' set only. FR-005 and US-3 require correlating regularity score with performance delta across the full spectrum to identify boundary conditions. Restricting to one set silently weakens the requirement to a subset analysis.

Task T029 calculates degradation percentage but omits the explicit verification step against the SC-004 threshold ('10% precision drop'). The acceptance criterion requires confirming the boundary condition; a calculation without the comparison/flagging step fails to satisfy the full acceptance criteria.

Task T007b (Annotation Extractor) is a prerequisite for FR-001 (ground-truth validation) but is described as incomplete/truncated in prior reviews. Proceeding with dependent tasks (T011, T019) without a verified implementation of this critical data hygiene step violates the requirement for valid ground-truth sourcing.

Task T027 cites Wikipedia for power analysis logic, violating Constitution Principle II (Verified Accuracy) which requires citations to be verified against primary sources. This introduces a non-compliant citation into the implementation plan.
